UKPN Distributed Generation Map

Distributed generation on the UK Power Networks network

Generation and storage across the Eastern (EPN), South Eastern (SPN) and London (LPN) licence areas. Marker colour shows the technology and marker shape shows the capacity band.

–MW shown
–sites shown

    Choose what to search by, then start typing. Picking a substation, operator or postcode lists its sites here; tap one to go to it. Use Layers for power cuts and headroom, Filters to narrow the sites, and Insights for oversubscribed primaries, power cut history and overdue connections.

    Power cuts

    Darker shading means more customers off supply in that power cut: under 10, 10 to 99, 100 to 999, 1,000 or more.

        Headroom vs pipeline

        Accepted-to-connect generation at 11 kV and below at each primary (named in the ECR, or located in its area) compared with its available generation headroom. 33 kV and 132 kV connections are left out because they don't use the primary transformers.

        Sources. UKPN Embedded Capacity Register (≥1 MW); DESNZ Renewable Energy Planning Database, Q2 2026. Boundaries © ONS / OS (2013 districts). Postcode sectors are built from ONS Postcode Directory unit postcodes (Feb 2026) and place names from OS Open Names, both under the Open Government Licence. The UKPN boundary, primary substation areas, capacity and headroom come from UKPN's primary substation postcode area dataset (open data portal). Both datasets licensed for open reuse.

        REPD operational and under-construction sites are matched to the ECR when a site with the same technology sits within 2 km. Matches are hidden by default so capacity is not counted twice. Sites under 1 MW (rooftop PV, small farm AD) are mostly absent from both registers.

        Update source data

        Load newer exports here and the map rebuilds itself in your browser. Files are processed on this device and never uploaded anywhere.

        Embedded Capacity Register

        UKPN ECR CSV export. Add the 1 MW and above register, and the 50 kW to 1 MW register too if you have it. Loading ECR files replaces all ECR sites.

        Renewable Energy Planning Database

        DESNZ REPD quarterly CSV. Replaces all REPD projects. It is matched against the ECR, so load both together if the ECR has changed too.

        Substations

        UKPN Grid and Primary Sites export (CSV or GeoJSON) from the open data portal, which needs a portal login. Any substation list with names and coordinates works.
